ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.05:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (dark black/grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Macro-scale solid black pigmentation; discrete high-contrast white linear streaks mapped to the lower-left interior and middle-right interior of the fluke lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped depression with an approximate central convergence angle of 35 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) observed continuously along the entire horizontal extent of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the outer leading edges of both lobes extending from the hinge point to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel groups localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; one prominent diagonal streak on the lower-left lobe and several smaller irregular streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized surface colonization or irregular growth visible on the extreme edges of both fluke tips; presence of rake-like scarring across the ventral surface.
